no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: All Metagenomi programs are preclinical/IND-pending as of the FY2025 10-K (filed Mar 5, 2026). Lead asset MGX-001 (hemophilia A, FVIII gene insertion) completed pre-IND meeting Q4 2025; IND submission targeted Q4 2026 with clinical trials initiating in 2027. Wave 1 Ionis collaboration targets (APOC3, TTR, AGT, undisclosed) are all in lead optimization. AT-III secreted protein deficiency is at NHP proof-of-concept stage. No company-sponsored or partner-sponsored P1/P2/P3 trials are active.
